tasks.title: ngv2/detonation_evidence_gate.py — deterministic detonation-evidence-kind gate (live_execution | static_assertion | mock_execution) that downgrades non-live verdicts from 'confirmed' to 'unproven'
acceptance_criteria: New pure module ngv2/detonation_evidence_gate.py is emitted WHOLE-FILE and exposes exactly one primary public function classify_detonation_evidence(report: dict) -> dict.
Return dict has EXACTLY three keys: evidence_kind ('live_execution'|'static_assertion'|'mock_execution'), may_confirm (bool), downgraded_verdict ('confirmed'|'unproven').

Classification is deterministic and fail-closed: a regex_assert/ast_assert method is static_assertion regardless of other keys; otherwise a truthy self_hosted_mock is mock_execution; otherwise live_execution requires BOTH ran_target and observed_runtime_effect truthy; everything else (including the empty dict) is static_assertion.

The gate is wired into the NobleGreed verdict path (the detonation→report→verdict chokepoint) such that no report can be promoted to 'confirmed' unless classify_detonation_evidence returns may_confirm == True; the wiring reference is the minimum needed to make the committed oracle's check_wired pass.

Module is pure: no I/O, no network, no subprocess, no filesystem read, no source parsing, no target import, no wall-clock, no randomness, no module-level side effects; stdlib only (typing if useful), no new third-party dependency.
The committed oracle tests/ngv2/test_detonation_evidence_gate_wired.py runs GREEN; no test is authored or altered.

spec.objective: Create the new pure module ngv2/detonation_evidence_gate.py exposing classify_detonation_evidence(report: dict) -> dict — a deterministic, fail-closed gate that classifies the EVIDENCE KIND behind a detonation report (live_execution | static_assertion | mock_execution) and forbids a 'confirmed' verdict unless the target was actually executed at runtime, closing the verified defect where a regex/AST source-pattern PoC (h2oai/h2ogpt file-read) was mislabeled a 'live detonation' and reported 'confirmed'. Wire it into the NobleGreed verdict chokepoint so a non-live verdict is downgraded to 'unproven'.
functional_requirements: Expose exactly one primary pure function `def classify_detonation_evidence(report: dict) -> dict` over a plain dict that may contain keys method, ran_target, target_endpoint, observed_runtime_effect, fs_effect, self_hosted_mock (any key may be absent), returning a dict with EXACTLY the three keys evidence_kind, may_confirm, downgraded_verdict.

Classify static_assertion when method is in {'regex_assert','ast_assert'} (this takes precedence over every other key), AND also when ran_target is falsy and there is no observed runtime effect; the empty/partial dict falls through to static_assertion (fail-closed: absent evidence is never live).

Classify mock_execution when self_hosted_mock is truthy and the method is not a static-assert method — a self-hosted mock run takes precedence over a live classification so a mock run can never be called live.

Classify live_execution ONLY when ran_target is truthy AND observed_runtime_effect is truthy AND self_hosted_mock is NOT truthy AND method is not a static-assert method; set may_confirm = (evidence_kind == 'live_execution') and downgraded_verdict = 'confirmed' iff may_confirm else 'unproven'.

Be wired into the NobleGreed verdict path (detonation→report→verdict chokepoint) so no report is promoted to 'confirmed' unless this gate returns may_confirm == True; keep the gate pure (no I/O, network, subprocess, filesystem, source parsing, target import, wall-clock, randomness, or module-level side effects) using stdlib only.
spec.interfaces: ngv2/detonation_evidence_gate.py exposes `def classify_detonation_evidence(report: dict) -> dict` returning {'evidence_kind': <'live_execution'|'static_assertion'|'mock_execution'>, 'may_confirm': <bool>, 'downgraded_verdict': <'confirmed'|'unproven'>}. Imported by the committed oracle as `from ngv2.detonation_evidence_gate import classify_detonation_evidence` and referenced on the existing NobleGreed verdict path so check_wired passes.
edge_cases: method='regex_assert' (with any other keys present) → evidence_kind='static_assertion', may_confirm=False, downgraded_verdict='unproven' (a pure source-pattern regex assertion is NOT a detonation).

self_hosted_mock=True together with a subprocess effect (method='subprocess', ran_target=True, observed_runtime_effect=True) → evidence_kind='mock_execution', may_confirm=False, downgraded_verdict='unproven' (running against your own mock is not running against the real target).

method='http_request', ran_target=True, observed_runtime_effect=True, self_hosted_mock=False → evidence_kind='live_execution', may_confirm=True, downgraded_verdict='confirmed' (the only path to 'confirmed').
Empty / missing-keys dict {} → evidence_kind='static_assertion', may_confirm=False, downgraded_verdict='unproven' (fail-closed; absent evidence is never live).
ast_assert method behaves identically to regex_assert (static_assertion) even when ran_target/observed_runtime_effect are truthy — the static-assert method dominates.
ran_target=True but observed_runtime_effect falsy (or absent) with a non-static, non-mock method → static_assertion (live requires BOTH truthy).

Emit ngv2/detonation_evidence_gate.py WHOLE-FILE (the new module under ngv2/** is free-tier and the patches path cannot create files). Read tests/ngv2/test_detonation_evidence_gate_wired.py as the source of truth for the exact branch table and the wiring assertion (check_wired) before implementing; do not change it. Implement classification with strict precedence: (1) if report.get('method') in {'regex_assert','ast_assert'}: static_assertion; (2) elif report.get('self_hosted_mock'): mock_execution; (3) elif report.get('ran_target') and report.get('observed_runtime_effect'): live_execution; (4) else: static_assertion. Then may_confirm = evidence_kind == 'live_execution'; downgraded_verdict = 'confirmed' if may_confirm else 'unproven'. # COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT (authoritative; you cannot read these files at synthesis time so they are reproduced verbatim -- your code MUST make them pass):

## tests/ngv2/test_detonation_evidence_gate_wired.py
```python
"""RED oracle for ngv2.detonation_evidence_gate -- the deterministic, fail-closed
gate that classifies a detonation report's EVIDENCE KIND (live_execution |
static_assertion | mock_execution) and forbids a "confirmed" verdict unless the
target was actually executed at runtime.

A PURE classifier over a dict: classify_detonation_evidence(report) ->
{evidence_kind, may_confirm, downgraded_verdict}. It runs/fuzzes/detonates
nothing; no I/O, network, clock, randomness, or module-level side effects.
Classification (fail-closed): regex_assert/ast_assert => static_assertion
regardless of other keys; else self_hosted_mock => mock_execution; else
live_execution requires ran_target AND observed_runtime_effect both truthy;
everything else (incl. empty dict) => static_assertion. may_confirm ==
(evidence_kind == "live_execution"); downgraded_verdict "confirmed" iff
may_confirm else "unproven".

This oracle is the *_wired reachability proof: importing
classify_detonation_evidence from the live ngv2.detonation_evidence_gate module
is the wiring contract.
"""
import json

from ngv2.detonation_evidence_gate import classify_detonation_evidence

RESULT_KEYS = {'evidence_kind', 'may_confirm', 'downgraded_verdict'}
KINDS = {'live_execution', 'static_assertion', 'mock_execution'}


# --- contract: exactly three keys, enum + invariants -----------------------
def test_return_shape_contract():
    res = classify_detonation_evidence({})
    assert set(res) == RESULT_KEYS
    assert res['evidence_kind'] in KINDS
    assert isinstance(res['may_confirm'], bool)
    assert res['downgraded_verdict'] in ('confirmed', 'unproven')


def test_mayconfirm_and_verdict_invariants():
    samples = [
        {'method': 'regex_assert'},
        {'self_hosted_mock': True, 'ran_target': True, 'observed_runtime_effect': True},
        {'method': 'http_request', 'ran_target': True, 'observed_runtime_effect': True},
        {},
    ]
    for r in samples:
        res = classify_detonation_evidence(r)
        assert res['may_confirm'] == (res['evidence_kind'] == 'live_execution')
        assert res['downgraded_verdict'] == ('confirmed' if res['may_confirm'] else 'unproven')


# --- (a) regex_assert is static, never confirmable -------------------------
def test_regex_assert_is_static_assertion():
    res = classify_detonation_evidence(
        {'method': 'regex_assert', 'ran_target': True, 'observed_runtime_effect': True})
    assert res['evidence_kind'] == 'static_assertion'
    assert res['may_confirm'] is False
    assert res['downgraded_verdict'] == 'unproven'


def test_ast_assert_is_static_assertion():
    res = classify_detonation_evidence({'method': 'ast_assert'})
    assert res['evidence_kind'] == 'static_assertion'
    assert res['may_confirm'] is False


# --- (b) self_hosted_mock + subprocess effect is mock_execution ------------
def test_self_hosted_mock_subprocess_is_mock_execution():
    res = classify_detonation_evidence(
        {'method': 'subprocess', 'ran_target': True,
         'observed_runtime_effect': True, 'self_hosted_mock': True})
    assert res['evidence_kind'] == 'mock_execution'
    assert res['may_confirm'] is False
    assert res['downgraded_verdict'] == 'unproven'


# --- (c) http_request + runtime effect, not mock -> live_execution ---------
def test_http_request_with_runtime_effect_is_live_execution_confirmed():
    res = classify_detonation_evidence(
        {'method': 'http_request', 'ran_target': True,
         'observed_runtime_effect': True, 'self_hosted_mock': False})
    assert res['evidence_kind'] == 'live_execution'
    assert res['may_confirm'] is True
    assert res['downgraded_verdict'] == 'confirmed'


# --- (d) empty dict fails closed to static_assertion -----------------------
def test_empty_report_fails_closed_to_static_assertion():
    res = classify_detonation_evidence({})
    assert res['evidence_kind'] == 'static_assertion'
    assert res['may_confirm'] is False
    assert res['downgraded_verdict'] == 'unproven'


# --- live_execution requires BOTH ran_target and observed_runtime_effect ---
def test_ran_target_without_observed_effect_is_static():
    res = classify_detonation_evidence({'ran_target': True})
    assert res['evidence_kind'] == 'static_assertion'
    assert res['may_confirm'] is False


# --- determinism -----------------------------------------------------------
def test_output_is_byte_stable_deterministic():
    r = {'method': 'http_request', 'ran_target': True, 'observed_runtime_effect': True}
    a = json.dumps(classify_detonation_evidence(r), sort_keys=True)
    b = json.dumps(classify_detonation_evidence(r), sort_keys=True)
    assert a == b

```
